# odinex_servers (Data Source)

Lists servers, optionally filtered by label selector and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_servers" "web" {
  with_selector = "role=web"
  with_statuses = ["running"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `with_selector` (String) Label selector, e.g. `env=prod,role`.
- `with_statuses` (List of String) Only servers with one of these statuses.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (List of Object) Matching servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
